description: Manage OVH (French European hosting provider) LoadBalancing IP backends.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: The IP address of the backend to update / modify / delete.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: The endpoint to use (for instance ovh-eu).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the LoadBalancing internal name (ip-X.X.X.X).

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: Determines the type of probe to use for this backend. Choices: "none" ← (default) "http" "icmp" "oco"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Determines whether the backend is to be created/modified or deleted. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout in seconds used to wait for a task to be completed. Default: 120

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Determines the weight for this backend. Default: 8

examples:
- name: Adds or modify the backend '212.1.1.1' to a loadbalancing 'ip-1.1.1.1'
  ovh_ip_loadbalancing:
    name: ip-1.1.1.1
    backend: 212.1.1.1
    state: present
    probe: none
    weight: 8
    endpoint: ovh-eu
    application_key: yourkey
    application_secret: yoursecret
    consumer_key: yourconsumerkey

- name: Removes a backend '212.1.1.1' from a loadbalancing 'ip-1.1.1.1'
  ovh_ip_loadbalancing:
    name: ip-1.1.1.1
    backend: 212.1.1.1
    state: absent
    endpoint: ovh-eu
    application_key: yourkey
    application_secret: yoursecret
    consumer_key: yourconsumerkey
